scope: Fix ConfigPage.tsx in the AIC dashboard

problems.description: API Key field uses browser type='password' which causes auto-fill issues
problems.solution: Custom masking: show first 4 and last 4 chars with **** in middle (e.g., 'sk-12****5678')

problems.description: BaseURL exists in both .env (PROVIDER_BASE_URL) and opencode.jsonc (provider.options.baseURL). They must show the SAME value
problems.solution: Single source of truth: read from opencode.jsonc provider.options.baseURL. Mirror to .env PROVIDER_BASE_URL on save. Show single BaseURL field in opencode panel.

problems.description: Left panel (.env vars) uses generic KEY=VALUE rows. Right panel (opencode) uses structured labeled inputs. Styles are inconsistent.
problems.solution: Both panels must use the same input style: labeled rows with consistent spacing, border, padding, and font sizes. Remove the raw KEY=VALUE rows from .env panel — replace with structured labeled inputs for the known .env vars (PROVIDER_ID, PROVIDER_BASE_URL, MODEL_THINKER, MODEL_CRAFTER, MODEL_SPRINTER, AIC_CTX_*).

requirements.title: API Key Masking
requirements.description: Display masked (first4****last4) by default. Show 'eye' toggle to reveal full key for editing. Never send full key to frontend unless user clicks reveal.

requirements.title: BaseURL Single Source of Truth
requirements.description: Read from opencode.jsonc provider.options.baseURL as source of truth. Mirror to .env PROVIDER_BASE_URL on save. Show single BaseURL field in opencode panel.

requirements.title: Consistent Form Styling
requirements.description: Both panels must use the same input style: labeled rows with consistent spacing, border, padding, and font sizes. Replace raw KEY=VALUE rows from .env panel with structured labeled inputs for known .env vars (PROVIDER_ID, PROVIDER_BASE_URL, MODEL_THINKER, MODEL_CRAFTER, MODEL_SPRINTER, AIC_CTX_*).
